summary: Ranked recommendation: make a no-baked/no-emissive cafeteria flashlight-validation map variant first, then rerun the existing orbit validation. The evidence is strong that additional example-side console/CVar attempts are not the fastest correct repair: scene_off_flashlight_off is a true no-flashlight-ever control but remains bright at median mean luma 136.208 after runtime light/skylight disabling, and the attempted show-flag path reports capture_show_flags_configured=false and console_commands.applied=0. A lower-level SPEAR/Unreal capture API change is the secondary path if the dark validation map still cannot reach near-black or if general show-flag isolation is required across arbitrary maps.

findings.message: The fastest correct repair is asset-side first: create a flashlight-validation map variant for /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 that has no baked/precomputed lighting, no emissive/unlit ambient materials visible to the camera, and no visible daylight/sky/backdrop surfaces that read as illumination in a lights-off render. This directly targets the residual mean luma 136.208 in the no-flashlight-ever control.

The cafeteria v2 generated source itself contains plausible residual non-ULight contributors: material warm_diffused_led_lens is authored with emission_strength=0.35, then assigned to rectangular_led_panel_diffuser_* and warm_wall_sconce_lens_* meshes; exterior_daylight_context includes pale_sky_strip_above_exterior_wall and exterior geometry visible through windows; the Blender world color is nonzero. These survive ordinary ULightComponent disabling.

The existing map also contains ordinary Unreal light components that the Python helper can disable, but disabling them is not sufficient. Validation report shows six CafeteriaV2 RectLights plus Setup_DirectionalLight, and Builder/Inspector evidence says scene-off zeroed/hidden 8 light components and one USkyLightComponent without materially changing brightness.

Additional runtime ShowFlag/console/CVar work is ranked below the map variant. Current metadata already shows scene_off_lighting_isolation.requested=true and engine_ini_applied=true, but capture_show_flags_configured=false for rgb and depth_meters, show_flag_settings_set=false, and scene_off_lighting_isolation_console_commands.applied=0 for 15 attempted ShowFlag commands. More console commands alone are unlikely to be the fastest path.

The lower-level API fallback is specific: modify the SPEAR capture component path around cpp/unreal_plugins/SpUnrealTypes/Source/SpUnrealTypes/SpSceneCaptureComponent2D.cpp and USpSceneCaptureComponent2D so Python/render settings can set and read back Unreal scene-capture show flags after Initialize(). Prior Inspector evidence found Initialize() can overwrite bAlwaysPersistRenderingState, so any show-flag or render-history setter must be applied or re-applied after Initialize()/initialize_sp_funcs and must expose readback metadata.

The user's live viewport brightening observation should not drive the primary repair. Inspector frame analysis did not show a simple monotonic saved-frame exposure ramp; scene_off_flashlight_off luma is orbit/view-dependent with median mean 136.208 and no-flashlight metadata. If the saved PNGs become near-black while the live render window still appears to brighten, treat that as viewport/render-history perception rather than failed saved-output validation.

Scout policy limited direct source inspection to docs/, .control-tower/, and src/; src/ is absent in this checkout. C++ and examples/ paths referenced here are grounded in result packets, docs, and run artifacts rather than fresh direct file reads.

follow_up_recommendations: Delegate next to Experimenter first, with Builder available for the editor script glue. Create /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark, preferably by duplicating/reimporting cafeteria_500sqft_v2 geometry and preserving camera/orbit-compatible scale. Source paths to use are in .control-tower/runs/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_20260701T150830Z/manifest.yaml and run_cafeteria_500sqft_v2.sh.

Experimenter asset steps: remove or darken the visible exterior_daylight_context meshes/materials; set warm_diffused_led_lens emission strength to 0 or replace its imported material instances with non-emissive dark/neutral materials; specifically handle rectangular_led_panel_diffuser_0..3, warm_wall_sconce_lens_0..1, pale_sky_strip_above_exterior_wall, and exterior visible-through-window actors/assets. Set WorldSettings force_no_precomputed_lighting=true where available, clear/remove any map BuiltData asset, and keep fixture lights movable/dynamic so scene-off runtime disabling can actually make the map dark.

Builder support steps if needed: adapt or add a small Unreal editor script modeled on .control-tower/runs/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_20260701T150830Z/scripts/add_unreal_lights_and_validate.py to duplicate the map, apply the material/world/lightmap changes, save the new map, and emit a validation report listing light actors, emissive-material replacements, world settings, and any remaining sky/fog/reflection/post-process actors.

Validation command after the asset variant exists: run the same workflow against the new map into a fresh output directory, for example SPEAR_ORBIT_MAP_PATH=/Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render --python /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/spear-env/bin/python --output-dir examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map. If the helper does not override the map during render because orbit_spec already embeds it, Builder should update orbit_spec or the helper so the validation uses the dark map path explicitly.

Acceptance checks: scene_off_flashlight_off metadata must still show no_flashlight_ever_control=true, spawn_flashlight=false, flashlight_ever_spawned_after_setting_setup=false, and flashlight_ever_enabled_after_setting_setup=false. RGB median mean luma must be below the existing diagnostic threshold 20.0, preferably below 5.0; residual_scene_off_illumination.likely_residual_environment_static_or_material_lighting must be false; scene_off_flashlight_on should show localized positive delta versus scene_off_flashlight_off rather than a globally bright baseline; depth frames should remain identical across lighting settings.

If the dark map still has median mean luma above 20, then delegate to Builder for the lower-level capture API. Target cpp/unreal_plugins/SpUnrealTypes/Source/SpUnrealTypes/SpSceneCaptureComponent2D.cpp and the corresponding header/bindings so run_orbit_collection.py can set and verify capture show flags for Lighting, SkyLighting, GlobalIllumination, IndirectLightingCache, VolumetricLightmap, ReflectionEnvironment, Fog, Atmosphere, and PostProcessing as appropriate. Acceptance for that path is metadata with capture_show_flags_configured=true, show_flag_settings_set=true, explicit disabled flag names, and the same near-black scene_off_flashlight_off luma threshold.

Do not spend the next Builder cycle only adding more console/CVar commands. Existing evidence says the console show-flag attempt applied zero commands and did not move luma. CVars can be retained as supplementary deterministic-render metadata, not as the primary repair.
memory_worthy: For bright scene-off orbit renders on cafeteria_500sqft_v2, repair the asset first: create a no-baked/no-emissive/no-daylight flashlight-validation map variant and require scene_off_flashlight_off median mean luma below 20 before treating scene_off_flashlight_on as flashlight-only. Lower-level USpSceneCaptureComponent2D show-flag/readback support is the fallback if the dark map cannot satisfy that acceptance check.
